checks: The real authenticated portal shows ingress availability separately from the unavailable executor and delivery.
A recent MFA login issues a private single-use link; issuing it grants no binding and status reloads reveal no link token.
A real private webhook proves the numeric identity; only the original portal login explicitly confirming creates the formal binding.
A separate administrator session explicitly enables the exact group and topic with a versioned, audited portal change.
The bound sender can inspect one durable request after identical webhook retries; another portal identity cannot see it and no executor completion is claimed.
A membership update pauses the group, withdraws pending work and appears as the latest actual channel revision in the portal.
The actual owner revokes the versioned binding in the UI; no active browser-created binding remains.
scope: Web with real native API and committed business events
